tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.re: Equip in a Soul Stone curio slot to activate. Increases mining speed by 6x and attack damage by 3x. 33% chance to trigger Matter Disintegration, dealing 5% of the target's max health as true damage (1s cooldown).
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.da: Equip in a Soul Stone curio slot to activate. Hold Shift + W to enter phase state and pass through stone, dirt, wood and ore blocks. Consumes 50 EMC per tick. Lasts up to 5 seconds, followed by a 10 second cooldown.
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.sa: Equip in a Soul Stone curio slot to activate. Brew without blaze powder; killing any monster has a 50% chance to drop a gold ingot. Press the bound key to run one Philosopher's Stone orb transmutation on every non-player creature in a 9x9 area (384 EMC each, 600s cooldown).
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.tr: Equip in a Soul Stone curio slot to activate. Press the bound key to open the Transmutation Table interface and pause game time.
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.el: Equip in a Soul Stone curio slot to activate. Immune to powder snow and fire damage. When you are attacked, the attacker is afflicted with Slowness VIII for 10 seconds.
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.al: Press the bound key to open the Alchemy Bag selector. Click any colored bag to open its storage space.
tooltip.projecte_soulstone_1785817675.eq: Grants every soul stone effect of this mod. Equip it in a Soul Stone curio slot, and use any soul stone bound key to trigger the corresponding ability.
